artifacts.used_by: hMailServerInnoExtension.iss line 94 declares CheckPorts@files:ISC.DLL; called at line 695
artifacts.why: WEAKEST PROVENANCE IN THE REPOSITORY. A 45 KB unsigned native DLL with no version resource, no publisher and no known upstream, loaded by the installer to test whether ports 25/110/143 are already in use. It is genuinely called, so it cannot simply be deleted - but it should be replaced by Inno Setup Pascal code or a rebuilt-from-source DLL.
